fomod.Name: Ragdoll Together (Ragdoll Physics Sync)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Shows every Skyrim Together Reborn player the same ragdoll: when a player or NPC is knocked down, flung by a shout, killed or knocked out, everyone sees the body fall, bounce, come to rest and get up exactly as on its owner's screen, instead of a stiff or T-posed body. Supports Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.3 from Nexus (Skyrim 1.7.104 and 1.6.1170/1.6.1179) and Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5 (Skyrim 1.7.104, 1.6.1170/1.6.1179 and 1.5.97).
